parsed.name: 通用 USB-FPGA 通信组件
parsed.description: 一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于扫描 USB 设备、连接 USB 转 UART 桥接器，并与 FPGA 板卡进行串口数据收发。它主要供上层实验软件用于发现设备、发送寄存器设置命令和轮询读取数据。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software communication component that scans USB devices, connects through a USB-to-UART bridge, and exchanges serial data with FPGA boards. It is used by higher-level lab software to discover devices, send register-setting commands, and poll for returned data.

actions.description: 初始化该非物理通信组件并启动 USB 连接检查流程。
actions.description_en: Initialize this non-physical communication component and start checking for USB connections.

actions.description: 轮询 USB 连接，扫描可用的 FPGA 相关设备并更新发现列表。
actions.description_en: Poll USB connections, scan for available FPGA-related devices, and update the discovered-device list.

actions.description: 连接选定的 USB 转 UART 设备，并配置串口参数以与 FPGA 通信。
actions.description_en: Connect to the selected USB-to-UART device and configure UART parameters for communication with the FPGA.

actions.description: 向 FPGA 寄存器发送设置命令并写入指定值。
actions.description_en: Send a set command to an FPGA register and write the specified value.

actions.description: 发送轮询请求，以启动或继续从 FPGA 获取连续返回数据。
actions.description_en: Send a poll request to start or continue receiving streaming response data from the FPGA.

actions.description: 通过 USB-UART 接收 FPGA 返回的数据，并在完整消息到达时通知上层软件。
actions.description_en: Receive data returned by the FPGA over USB-UART and notify higher-level software when a complete message arrives.

actions.description: 重启接收定时器，以持续周期性检查接收缓冲区。
actions.description_en: Restart the receive timer to continue periodically checking the receive buffer.

actions.description: 在软件关闭时停止定时器并断开 USB 通信。
actions.description_en: Stop timers and disconnect USB communication when the software is closing.
